speech.title: Single-speaker speech
speech.notice: Send text to the displayed MOSS account to generate one speaker. Charges may apply. Playback never starts automatically; Flash streaming plays only when requested. Canceling stops local waiting, not necessarily provider work or charges. Generated audio supports up to 512 MB per file. Results over 25 MiB stay in Media storage only you can reach, share its 2 GiB quota with uploaded inputs, and cannot be published to a channel.
speech.configure: Select a speech connection and Flash or Pro model in AI services first.
speech.voiceHint: Voices belong to the displayed account. Listing a voice does not verify generation permission or quality.
speech.emptyVoices: This account returned no voices on this page.
speech.downloadOnly: This format is download-only on this device. Raw PCM has no self-describing playback parameters.
speech.pending: The request ID and original account, configuration, voice, text and format are frozen. Retrying the same submission retrieves the same task; it never regenerates an uncertain result. Choose a new request to change inputs or generate again.
speech.empty: No speech tasks yet. Configure a speech connection, choose a voice and enter text.

understanding.title: Understand images and video
understanding.notice: Select 1–5 images (up to 30 MB each), or one video (up to 200 MB); do not mix them. Files are first stored on this computer, then sent to the displayed MOSS connection after your approval. Charges may apply. Canceling does not guarantee that the provider stopped.
understanding.configure: Select an understanding connection in AI services first.
understanding.authorizationNotice: Freeze this prompt, input and output limit without uploading to MOSS yet. An assistant acting for you in the selected channel may execute it once within 15 minutes. Cancellation, expiry or a server restart invalidates approval.
understanding.authorization: Authorized channel: {channel}. Send to the assistant to begin. Approval expires 15 minutes after registration.
understanding.delegation: Execute my authorized media understanding task {id}, then report the result.
understanding.consent: I approve sending these files and this prompt to the displayed MOSS connection.
understanding.uploading: Storing selected files on this computer…
understanding.uploadFailed: Local upload failed. This submission has not started understanding; retry or select the files again.
understanding.newAsk: Start a new request? This may upload again and incur another charge. It will not recover an unknown earlier result.
understanding.pending: The request ID is retained for retries. Repeating this submission does not upload or run inference again. A different question requires a new request.
understanding.truncated: This result is incomplete. The retained text is shown below; increasing the output limit requires a new request and may incur another charge.
understanding.usage: Provider reported: {input} input tokens · {output} output tokens · {total} total
understanding.cleanupAsk: Delete known remote files and release retained local inputs? The provider may still be processing an unknown request. Uploads without a confirmed ID may remain and need manual inspection. This does not repeat understanding.

usageUnknown: No provider usage result yet. This does not mean there was no charge.
newAsk: Create a new generation request? It may incur another charge and will not recover an unknown previous result.
notice: Submission sends your input to MOSS and may incur charges. Timing out or canceling local waiting does not mean the provider stopped computing. Generation is never automatically retried.
pending: This input has been submitted. Retry the same submission after a network interruption, or explicitly start a new generation to change parameters or generate again.
empty: No generation tasks yet. Configure an image connection, then submit a prompt.
cancelAsk: Stop waiting locally? The provider may still be generating or charging.
releaseAsk: Release unshared local audio and permanently abandon this request's resume/download retries? Transcripts, voices, published attachments and history remain. Remote processing and charges may continue; audio will not be regenerated.
